endpoint.title: Valhalla endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the Valhalla server. Defaults to Stadia Maps (https://api.stadiamaps.com), which needs an API key below. Leave blank to use the default, point at a self-hosted service resolved via the `valhalla` capability, or set another Valhalla-compatible host.

apiKey.title: Valhalla API key
apiKey.description: API key appended as `?api_key=` to requests. Required for Stadia Maps (free non-commercial tier); leave blank for key-less self-hosted instances. Also settable via the VALHALLA_API_KEY env var.

dataSources.name: Valhalla (Stadia Maps)
dataSources.notes: Default Valhalla host. Free tier requires an API key (VALHALLA_API_KEY) and is limited to non-commercial / evaluation use; commercial use needs a paid Stadia plan. A self-hosted or other Valhalla-compatible endpoint can be set via VALHALLA_URL (no key).
